notes.title: Doomed Patch Notes V0.4.12
notes.notes:
Main Updates
Added English demo

Added Japanese demo

Added judge content

Added a note entry after events


Other Updates
The "Load Game" menu is now grayed out when there is no saved data

Fixed a bug where other characters' affection levels were displayed incorrectly

The first bus stop event no longer occurs after 6 p.m

Added a sparkling effect to the perfume part of the intro

Event images now have borders

Fixed an error where the nickname "Dollstar Jinda" was not visible
